description: This Java class is a junit test class for creating and exporting initial database data sets using DBUnit within the OpenMRS project. It is used to generate XML representations of specific database tables, mainly for testing or data migration purposes.

classes.name: CreateInitialDataSet
classes.description: A junit test class designed to create XML data sets from the database tables for use in testing. It can be run manually to export specific tables into an XML file.

methods.name: shouldCreateInitialTestDataSetXmlFile
methods.description: Creates an XML dataset from selected database tables and writes it to a file, useful for setting up test scenarios or data migration.

methods.name: useInMemoryDatabase
methods.description: Overrides default to indicate this test does not use an in-memory database, but connects to the real database specified by runtime configurations.
